label: Pet Contents Vertical Webtoon V1
description: raw pet episode narrative를 받아 storyboard/webtoon cuts를 먼저 만들고, style lock과 camera plan을 고정한 뒤 motion-ready keyframes, scene video, dubbing, SFX, typography로 이어지는 pet-content 포맷.

runnerHints.intakeStage: if the Paperclip issue title starts with [Pet Contents], treat the raw issue narrative as enough input to bootstrap the episode packet
runnerHints.sourceStage: lock the observed episode truth, cast, setting, safety notes, and optional narration script before creative generation
runnerHints.styleLockStage: if cast already exists under characters/<slug>, derive a reusable style-lock prompt from their character bibles and refs; otherwise derive a provisional style lock from the raw narrative and save it before storyboard generation
runnerHints.storyboardStage: generate 8 to 10 webtoon-like storyboard cuts through the codex_local agent using OpenAI GPT Image 2 and store them under storyboard/webtoon-cuts before scene-video work
runnerHints.storyboardProviderRule: treat Duct Tape as a non-canonical reference, and use GPT Image 2 as the default storyboard image model unless the issue explicitly approves another tool
runnerHints.keyframeStage: convert approved storyboard cuts into motion-friendly keyframes and handoff frames for scene-video generation
runnerHints.cameraStage: write an explicit camera plan per cut or scene including movement type, intensity, duration intent, and transition note
runnerHints.pictureStage: generate sequential vertical scenes using the previous scene last frame as the next scene starting state
runnerHints.postStage: after picture lock, apply narration dubbing, SFX, BGM, typography, color treatment, and QA against the post-production checklist

sceneGenerationPolicy.sceneStartRule: scene-01 starts from approved storyboard or keyframe anchor; later scenes start from the previous scene final frame
sceneGenerationPolicy.sceneBoundaryRule: scene-n final frame and scene-(n+1) opening frame should begin from the same state before motion continues
sceneGenerationPolicy.scenePoseTargetRule: approved storyboard cuts and keyframes define the intended composition, emotion, and motion direction for each scene
sceneGenerationPolicy.defaultCompositionRule: keep pet identity stable, keep environmental continuity readable, and avoid actual dangerous ingestion or threatening animal behavior

scriptPolicy.defaultNarrationRule: prefer story-driven narration derived from the issue `대본:` or a compressed retelling of the observed episode rather than dialogue-heavy exchanges
scriptPolicy.timingPriority: if narration script exists, runtime follows the local timing pass before visual beats are split into scenes
scriptPolicy.captionRule: captions are sparse and should support emotion, timing, or payoff instead of paraphrasing every spoken line

audioPolicy.timingGuideRule: if narration script exists, estimate rough timing with a local/basic no-paid-API guide TTS or equivalent timing pass before final scene durations are locked
